query: SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Seoul')) AS day, event, uniq(uuid) AS events, uniq(distinct_id) AS observed_installation_ids FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-15 15:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-18 15:00:00','UTC') AND properties.client = 'seodang-capacitor' AND properties.environment = 'production' GROUP BY day,event ORDER BY day,event LIMIT 100
